description: Lists every served GraphQL root field. query-api enforces no catalog action (actions.v1.json) on a field today, so every action is unknown with a declared gap. Every other statement is held to a source proof by the Go guard.

rows.disclosure_behavior: a request with no organization answers AUTHORIZATION_ERROR; an orgId naming another organization answers a whole-operation error before any field runs, except that a verified non-impersonating superuser may name another organization and the operation then runs against it
